difficulty_reason: The lemma reformulates the defining condition for a ring to be a P-ring: instead of quantifying over a prime and a prime below it in the ring itself, one may quantify over pairs of primes and use the completion of the quotient by the smaller prime. The proof exhibits the identity of algebras over the residue field which identifies the two families of algebras being tested, so that the two conditions are the same condition written in two ways. The identity is the whole content of the reformulation and is displayed explicitly.
